application_type_full: Approval of details reserved by a condition (discharge)
decision_conditions: The Applicant is advised that this application relates to details pursuant to the partial discharge of Condition 13 (Part i (a) only of prior approval reference 40050/APP/2025/1876, dated 10-10-2025. Further details are required in order to fully discharge the condition.
description: Details pursuant to the partial discharge of Condition 13 (part i (a) only - Contamination) of prior approval reference 40050/APP/2025/1876, dated 10-10-2025, for 'Change of use from Commercial (Use Class E) to Residential (Use Class C3) to create 56 dwellings (Application for Prior Approval under Schedule 2, Part 3, Class MA of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) (England) Order 2015 (as amended)).
